name: devgraph
description: DevGraph - a graph-powered developer skill and career relationship explorer, backed by CognoDB.

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix client install && npm --prefix server install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client"
scripts.build: npm run build:server && npm run build:client
scripts.lint: npm --prefix server run lint && npm --prefix client run lint
